subject: Performance risk mitigation: proposed pre-PIP coaching plan (sensitive)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: talentops@peopleservices.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Performance risk mitigation: proposed pre-PIP coaching plan (sensitive)

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Summary: I had a difficult 1:1 this morning with an IC on my team (role: Senior ML Engineer, name redacted). Over the last 6 months we've seen repeated missed delivery commitments, unclear technical designs that caused rework, and limited collaboration with the product squad. I want to escalate early and keep this as a documented pre-PIP coaching intervention.

Why now: the trend is recent and accelerating (Missed Q3 sprint commits, three rollbacks linked to design gaps). I believe there's still runway for an outcome-focused coaching plan that avoids formal PIP if we see sustained improvement.

Proposed immediate actions (draft):
- 30-60-90 expectation doc attached (30-60-90-expectations.docx).
- Weekly 1:1s focused on deliverable commitments, and a standing 30-min technical design review with product and a senior peer.
- Clear measurable success criteria: on-time completion of the two priority roadmap items in the next 60 days, one peer-reviewed design accepted without rework, and evidence of proactive communication in sprint planning.
- Documented weekly notes uploaded to HR case and manager file.

Privacy / process asks: please advise preferred wording for the coaching memo and whether we should inform People Ops before the first follow-up meeting. I attached a compact evidence digest (evidence-digest.pdf) summarizing missed milestones and examples.

Next steps I propose:
1) HR confirms process and templates by EOD Tuesday.
2) I hold a short alignment meeting with the IC tomorrow (already scheduled) and record notes.
3) We reconvene in two weeks to review progress and determine if formal PIP is necessary.

Happy to talk on a quick call if preferred.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence-digest.pdf (summary, 6 pages), 30-60-90-expectations.docx (editable plan)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, talentops@peopleservices.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Performance risk mitigation: proposed pre-PIP coaching plan (sensitive)

Kimberly — thanks for the detailed context and for moving early. Important points: we should treat this as a confidential manager-led coaching track (pre-PIP). People Ops prefers that managers document actions and progress; we keep PII minimal in shared links.

Immediate guidance:
- Use the attached template for the coaching memo (template-coaching-letter.docx). It standardizes expectations and preserves escalation paths.
- Upload evidence-digest.pdf and the 30-60-90 plan to HR case HR-2026-1123 (I've added a placeholder entry).
- Schedule the first formal coaching check-in in 7 days and document outcomes (one-on-one-notes-20261130.pdf).
- If at any point the employee disputes factual items, loop in TalentOps (talentops@peopleservices.com) before moving to formal PIP.

On confidentiality: avoid copying the company-wide leadership alias. Keep the thread to direct stakeholders. If legal review looks necessary (esp. around role changes), escalate to legal@redwood.com.

Process reminder for managers: the pre-PIP coaching window is typically 30–60 days. Managers should capture observable behaviors and measurable success criteria rather than subjective language. Your proposed measures look appropriate; I suggest tightening success criteria to exact deliverables (e.g., "complete feature X with <5% rework" rather than general improvement).

I'll stand by for the initial meeting notes and will review once uploaded.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal People Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachment: template-coaching-letter.docx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: talentops@peopleservices.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Performance risk mitigation: proposed pre-PIP coaching plan (sensitive) — 1:1 notes

Marissa / Laura — quick update after today's 1:1 with the IC. I used the template and focused on measurable outcomes; the meeting was documented and the employee has acknowledged the concerns and the plan. Summary notes attached (one-on-one-notes-20261130.pdf).

Key commitments from the IC:
- Commit to a prioritized backlog for the next 60 days with weekly deliverable checkpoints.
- Pair with a senior engineer for design reviews (scheduled twice weekly for first 30 days).
- Weekly status emails to the manager + product lead with explicit blockers and ETA updates.

Manager actions recorded:
- I will run the design reviews and unblock priority work as needed.
- Uploading our evidence digest and the updated 30-60-90 expectations to the HR case now.

Updated 30-60-90 doc attached with tighter acceptance criteria (30-60-90-expectations.docx). I plan to review progress after two weekly cycles (approx. 14 days) and then decide whether to continue coaching or escalate to formal PIP.

If either of you thinks we should change cadence (shorter window, include CS for customer-impact items), let me know. Otherwise I will proceed with the schedule and upload artifacts.

Thanks,

Kim

Attachments: one-on-one-notes-20261130.pdf, 30-60-90-expectations.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Performance risk mitigation: proposed pre-PIP coaching plan (sensitive) — 1:1 notes

Thanks for the thorough handling, Kim. I reviewed the notes and the updated 30-60-90 — those expectations are appropriately specific. I support the manager-led coaching path and the two-week check-in cadence.

One ask: if after the two-week check-in we are not seeing clear forward motion, please loop legal before issuing a formal PIP so we confirm contractual obligations and any comp implications. Also keep communications minimal to the people copied in this thread.

Appreciate the proactive documentation.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Infrastructure and Serving
Redwood Inference
